scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:worker"
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:worker
scripts.deploy: bun run build:web && bun run --cwd apps/worker deploy
scripts.typecheck:packages: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/compatibility typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/database typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/feeds typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/api typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/database test && bun run --cwd packages/feeds test && bun run --cwd packages/api test
